apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(player): use the swap icon for change source (`78df57b5`)
- feat(ui): show hover labels with the bound shortcut on desktop controls (`daa26c7f`)
- feat(player): add change source button and show info button on mobile (`8a2c083a`)
- feat(menu): add mark as watched to continue watching series cards (`de4bb1a7`)
- fix(torrent): serve thumbnail reads only from cached data during playback (`7394d71b`)
- Revert "fix(torrent): hold probe reads until the playback buffer is full" (`1964267d`)
- fix(torrent): hold probe reads until the playback buffer is full (`beb131e4`)
- fix(logging): forward mpv messages to the session log (`e26923c4`)
- feat(menu): add play manually to cards, episodes and the detail play button (`16bf5415`)
- fix(player): close on back instead of minimizing (`06d77533`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4
